'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 2 Reid Smith LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' R. Smith
* '''Deck name:''' Space &#91;redacted&#93; TRM
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
